item.title: Want to invest in real estate without buying a house? India’s REIT market is booming
item.description: India's Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) are capturing the spotlight as the market witnesses significant expansion. Investors have the opportunity to acquire shares in publicly traded REITs or enhance their portfolios through mutual funds and ETFs, promoting diversification. The growth is further fueled by increasing office space availability and strong demand from multinational firms, making the REIT landscape a compelling investment option for individuals and institutions alike.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: Google Brain founder does not agree that AI is coming to kill humans
item.description: Andrew Ng addresses fears surrounding artificial intelligence, dismissing them as a result of misleading public relations rather than genuine technical concerns. He stresses that AI should not be misconstrued as an autonomous danger, calling for greater accountability from its creators. Instead of halting development, Ng promotes proactive engineering measures to enhance safety, arguing that the actual capabilities of AI technologies do not warrant the anxieties currently expressed.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Railway tracks capable of 130 kmph speed rise 5x in 12 years, but punctuality is 77%
item.description: According to recent Ministry of Railways data released, about 54,600 km of railway tracks were renewed between 2014 and February 2026, with track renewal and upgrading being carried out based on factors such as the age, traffic load and condition of the track.
item.dc:creator: TOI BUSINESS DESK

item.title: 'Strategic desperation': Iran on Trump's 'annihilate Islamic Republic' remark
item.description: Iranian military authorities said Trump's remarks showed the difficulties facing the US in its confrontation with Iran. They argued that repeated threats were not evidence of American strength, but reflected what they described as exhaustion within the US military. The statement also accused the US of creating instability in West Asia through its military presence in the region.
item.dc:creator: RAJEEV SINGH

item.title: Libra season begins: How it will impact each zodiac sign
item.description: As Libra season unfolds, it's a perfect moment to reflect on our connections and personal objectives, inviting a quest for harmony in our lives. Aries should consider the necessity of mutual contributions in their relationships, while Taurus may find it beneficial to overhaul their daily habits. For Gemini, rekindled relationships may arise—exercise caution with past ties.
item.dc:creator: SIDHHARRTH S KUMAAR

item.title: Washington bridge carrying 90,000 vehicles a day gets $114m overhaul
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Concrete oyster reefs boosted biomass 45-fold within 2 years, study finds
item.description: Innovative artificial oyster reefs have been created off Prince Edward Island to boost marine biodiversity and create habitats. In just two years, these structures attracted 45 different species, enhancing biomass significantly. They also offered vital surfaces for oyster growth, improving environmental conditions. The initiative, in collaboration with Lennox Island First Nation, highlights the ecological and cultural significance of restoring oyster populations and demonstrates new methods for revitalizing coastal ecosystems.
item.dc:creator: TOI SCIENCE DESK

item.title: Salesforce CEO blames Microsoft for not investing in OpenAI
item.description: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff says Microsoft's stake in OpenAI stopped his company from investing in the ChatGPT maker. Speaking on Alex Heath's Sources podcast, Benioff said Sam Altman turned him down, pushing Salesforce towards rival Anthropic. That early 2023 bet is reportedly worth about $5 billion, and Benioff believes it could earn Salesforce tens of billions as Claude maker Anthropic prepares for a public listing.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Phillip Island removed foxes; little penguin colony grew from 12,000 to 40,000
item.dc:creator: TOI SCIENCE DESK

item.title: Half-burnt body of woman found in UP, toddler found crying nearby
item.description: On Wednesday morning, a half-burnt body of a woman was discovered in a sugarcane field. Nearby, her nearly 18-month-old daughter was found crying and in need of care. The police suspect the woman was strangled before her body was transported to the field. Authorities are attempting to identify the woman and investigate the circumstances surrounding her death.
item.dc:creator: HARVEER DABAS

item.title: Bank stopped widow from accessing matured FDs; commission orders Rs 13.87L payment
item.description: A cooperative bank in Kerala restricted a woman's withdrawals after her fixed deposits matured and were transferred. The woman needed the funds for her mother's medical treatment and gold loan repayment. Despite the bank's claims of irregularities, the district consumer commission found they provided inadequate justification. The commission awarded the woman Rs 13.87 lakh and additional compensation for her distress.
item.dc:creator: SAURABH THAKUR

item.title: ‘Want to see him under pressure’: NZ coach's challenge for Vaibhav Sooryavanshi
item.description: Rob Walter has shown great enthusiasm in witnessing Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's adaptation to the challenging playing conditions of New Zealand. This T20I series will be Sooryavanshi's inaugural experience on the bouncy pitches of New Zealand, which promises to be enlightening. Walter, the head coach, believes that facing pressure is vital for player development, especially as New Zealand makes its T20I return after a tough World Cup final loss.
item.dc:creator: PRANAV SHUKLA

item.title: Rats filmed running across tables at Rajkot McDonald's, civic body takes action
item.description: In Rajkot, a customer recorded a video of two rats in a McDonald's outlet. The civic food department confirmed the incident and conducted an inspection of the restaurant. Following the findings, an administrative charge of Rs 3,000 was imposed on the establishment. This action was part of a larger drive against food adulteration and unhygienic practices in the city.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: A kidney wait since 2024 ends with an Army airlift and a rare double transplant
item.dc:creator: ANUJA JAISWAL

item.title: IIT-Bombay on boil: Professor sent on leave, student's parents 'driven' out of city
item.description: Sahil Wakode's parents were allegedly taken out of Mumbai against their wishes by unidentified individuals. They plan to start a hunger strike for justice outside IIT-Bombay, demanding prompt arrests. The Mumbai Crime Branch is investigating the circumstances surrounding Sahil's death. Allegations suggest caste-based discrimination contributed to the student's distress before his tragic death. The family expresses their determination for a fair investigation and accountability for those involved.
item.dc:creator: HEMALI CHHAPIA

item.title: Peacemaker with a warning to annihilate: The major contradictions in Trump's UN speech
item.description: Trump used much of his address to the General Debate of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly to list his achievements, much as he did a year ago when he cast himself as the standout contender for the Nobel Peace Prize. This year, though, the prize went unmentioned. Instead, his tone hardened, with attacks on the International Criminal Court (ICC), the UN's climate agenda and Unesco.
item.dc:creator: RAJEEV SINGH

item.title: Widow gets job after husband's death; Rajasthan HC orders 25% salary to mother-in-law
item.description: A widow employed through a compassionate appointment must allocate part of her salary to her mother-in-law. The Rajasthan high court acknowledged that the widow halted financial support after remarrying. She initially committed to providing for her family when applying for the position. The court's decision mandates that 25 percent of her salary be deducted for the elderly mother.
item.dc:creator: SAURABH THAKUR

item.title: Paid Rs 84,960 for '100% placement guarantee', got no job: MBA graduate wins refund
item.description: A district consumer commission in Punjab has mandated Eduinx Education Services to refund Rs 84,960 to an MBA graduate. This decision arose after the company was unable to deliver on its promise of guaranteed placement. Harish Malhotra, the complainant, sought compensation due to the company’s failure to fulfill its representation. The commission determined that Eduinx's claims constituted unfair trade practices.
item.dc:creator: SAURABH THAKUR

item.title: Tasmania treated invasive grass; fish species more than doubled in 3 years
item.description: Tasmania’s Duck Bay wetland is showing signs of recovery after years of work to remove invasive rice grass. Circular Head Landcare has reduced the weed from about 50 hectares to five, allowing native saltmarsh plants to return. University of Tasmania scientists found fish species increased from five to 11, with yellow-eye mullet and other species returning to restored areas.
item.dc:creator: TOI SCIENCE DESK

item.title: Quote of the day by Meg Ryan
item.description: Meg Ryan emphasizes the vital role that small acts of kindness can play in uplifting mothers and children worldwide. During a visit to New Light in Kolkata, she gained a deeper understanding of the struggles faced by many. Ryan urges individuals to get involved in various capacities, stressing that support can take forms beyond finances. By ensuring access to essential healthcare and education, modest contributions can profoundly enhance lives.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: 'White House access privilege, not right': DOJ backs Trump barring reporters
item.description: The Trump administration has claimed the authority to restrict access for journalists to the White House. It argues that access is a privilege and not a right, citing national security concerns. The Justice Department emphasizes that First Amendment rights do not guarantee access to the complex. In response, CNN, MS NOW, and Politico are challenging these restrictions in federal court.
item.dc:creator: PRISHA PATNAIK

item.title: Russian oligarch’s wedding gift to Trump Jr puts family dealings under scrutiny
item.description: Senator John Curtis has called for a thorough Senate investigation into Donald Trump Jr's financial ties to a Russian oligarch amid mounting concerns of potential corruption linked to Umar Kremlev's extravagant wedding celebration. This move seeks to ensure that Trump Jr's foreign business dealings are examined fairly, especially as political dynamics shift ahead of the midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: SHIVANGHI PAYAL

item.title: Operation Sindoor lessons baked in to IAF's multilateral Tarang Shakti wargames
item.description: The multi-nation air exercise Tarang Shakti will take place at the Indian Air Force base in Jodhpur. Scheduled from September 26 to October 11, the exercise will involve around 40 countries. The Indian Air Force aims to integrate lessons from Operation Sindoor into training scenarios during the drills. This training will include various air operations involving advanced aircraft and combat scenarios.
item.dc:creator: DHRUV YADAV

item.title: Back home on leave, army man 'beaten to death' by drunk youths in road rage
item.description: Six individuals were arrested and sent to judicial custody for allegedly killing a soldier from the Assam Regiment. The soldier, Zakaria Lalhriattluanga, was attacked after arriving in Mizoram following his posting in Jammu and Kashmir. This incident occurred near Bualpui village following an altercation over poor road conditions. The accused include both adults and minors, with two minors placed in juvenile custody.
item.dc:creator: HC VANLALRUATA

item.title: Simon Cowell to miss America’s Got Talent finale over health concerns
item.description: Simon Cowell will not participate in America’s Got Talent Season 21 finale as he recovers from surgery. His absence opens up his spot for YouTuber KSI, who will be a guest judge. KSI will join judges Howie Mandel, Sofia Vergara, and Mel B during the performances and results episode. Simon's health issues led to guest judges filling in while he was away.
item.dc:creator: etimes.in

item.title: Gwalior teen raped by 17-year-old neighbour on day of Jamui horror
item.description: A Class 10 student in Bihar was molested on the same day a Gwalior girl was raped. The Gwalior girl, 16, was approached by her 17-year-old neighbor who blackmailed her with private photos. After forcing her to a flat, he allegedly raped her and later released her. The accused had previously stalked her and threatened her with the morphed images.
item.dc:creator: AMARJEET SINGH

item.title: Trump to increase presence with two ‘very big’ military bases in Greenland
item.dc:creator: PRANJAL PANDEY

item.title: How 3 men posing as cops turned 17-year-old’s birthday outing into a nightmare
item.description: A 17-year-old girl from Faridabad was allegedly raped by three men in Aastha Kunj Park. After visiting Kalkaji Temple, she and her male friend entered the park and faced intimidation. The men, posing as police, threatened to inform their parents about their actions. During the incident, the men physically assaulted the girl's friend before taking her to a secluded area.
item.dc:creator: ABHAY

item.title: UP man kills wife, 2 priests, takes 3 children hostage; shot dead after 7-hour standoff
item.description: A police encounter resulted in the death of Arvind Singh after he refused to surrender during a standoff. During the incident, he was holding his three children hostage, leading to a police operation. Arvind had killed his wife and two priests following a dispute concerning a religious ritual at home. His eight-year-old son was also critically injured and later died from his injuries.
item.dc:creator: PATHIKRIT CHAKRABORTY

item.title: LSR cancels classes, goes online after Kalkaji Mandir gang rape case
item.description: Lady Shri Ram College cancelled regular classes and shifted them online after a 17-year-old girl was allegedly gang-raped at Aastha Kunj Park near Kalkaji Mandir. Police said three men, posing as policemen, allegedly separated the girl from her male friend and assaulted her in a secluded area. All three accused have been arrested, while police are investigating the incident and checking for possible links to other cases.
item.dc:creator: SIDDHI DHARMADHIKARI

item.title: 'Almost all agents' data stolen? Hackers claim FBI job site breach, stole 2TB of data
item.description: The FBI is currently investigating a cyberattack on its job application website, FBIjobs.gov. ShinyHunters claimed to have stolen over 2 terabytes of sensitive data related to FBI employees and applicants. The group alleged they accessed information through a vulnerability in Oracle’s PeopleSoft system. Cybersecurity experts expressed concerns about the potential long-term risks for affected individuals if the data circulates further.
item.dc:creator: PRISHA PATNAIK

item.title: How rising house prices have forced Taiwan to settle for ‘haunted homes’
item.description: In Taiwan, the soaring property prices are leading buyers to consider 'haunted houses,' which come at significantly lower prices due to their grim pasts. Many banks are reluctant to finance these homes, fearing future resale challenges and negative superstitions. Before they move in, buyers often engage in spiritual rituals to honor the spirits, showcasing how traditional beliefs continue to shape the modern housing market in Taiwan.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: Trump buys up to $50,000 of Musk’s SpaceX, sells some a week later
item.description: In July, Donald Trump showcased his financial acumen with substantial investments, notably entering and exiting positions in Elon Musk's SpaceX. His trading spectrum also included major players like Microsoft and Amazon, totaling over 1,150 transactions, highlighting a well-rounded investment strategy. Furthermore, he delved into several bond purchases and efficiently maneuvered through exchange-traded funds, demonstrating a proactive approach to managing his financial portfolio amid prior activities.
item.dc:creator: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
